newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Aug 1-15 palm oil exports 312,757t-SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Aug 1-15 palm oil exports 312,757t-SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said on Friday it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for August 1-15 at 312,757 tonnes against 307,536 tonnes for July 1-15.
It said the exports comprised 79,774 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 133,449 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 23,009 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products totalled 76,525 tonnes.
India was the top buyer during the period, taking 58,375 tonnes, followed by China which bought 45,404 tonnes, Pakistan (45,400) and Turkey (20,434 tonnes).
Countries in the European Union bought 33,096 tonnes.
